output.summary: Incident growth outpaces volume (+7%) and the EU share is small. The tool migration only affected SEV3-SEV4. The strongest explanation is a self-reinforcing loop: interrupt load displaces reliability work, so overdue action items recur as incidents. Storage's exemption (11 of 13 items closed, pages down) and Networking's failed second-slot pilot (acknowledgment unchanged, more incidents, higher burden) back this. Coverage is not the binding constraint, so A1 would cut on-call frequency to about 1 week in 3. Ring-fencing engineers to close recurring items is preferred. Pay-versus-on-call attrition is unresolved, so spending the whole budget on pay is premature. Incident targets risk reviving the 2023 misclassification.
